trace.cypher:
MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest'
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, p.name AS col2, p.mvp_awards AS col3, p.birth_date AS col4, p.name AS name_player
UNION
MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WHERE r.tenure = 'earlier'
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[latest:PlaysFor]->(:Team) WHERE latest.tenure = 'latest' }
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, p.name AS col2, p.mvp_awards AS col3, p.birth_date AS col4, p.name AS name_player
